native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'servo1': '0°', 'servo2': '0°', 'servo3': '0°', 'bargraph1': 'all off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. All servos start at 0° and the LED bar graph is off.'}

test2: {'time': 3.0, 'state': {'servo1': '18°', 'servo2': '18°', 'servo3': '18°', 'bargraph1': '1 LED on'}, 'description': 'First movement phase. After 2 seconds, all servos increase to 18° simultaneously. The total angle is 54, lighting 1 LED on the bar graph.'}

test3: {'time': 7.5, 'state': {'servo1': '54°', 'servo2': '54°', 'servo3': '54°', 'bargraph1': '3 LEDs on'}, 'description': 'Third movement phase. After 4 seconds (two increments), all servos reach 54°. The total angle is 162, lighting 3 LEDs on the bar graph.'}

test4: {'time': 20.0, 'state': {'servo1': '180°', 'servo2': '180°', 'servo3': '180°', 'bargraph1': '10 LEDs on'}, 'description': 'Peak movement phase. After 12 seconds (six increments), all servos reach 180°. The total angle is 540, lighting all 10 LEDs on the bar graph.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
